narrative.details:
My recipe is complete! What I need from you now is some rocket fuel and deeprock salt. I'll handle the spices and the meat you brought me will cover the rest.

After you bring me what I asked for, the chicken will be ready to take back to Narain.
narrative.objectives: Dirge Quikcleave in Gadgetzan wants you to bring him 20 Goblin Rocket Fuel and 20 Deeprock Salt.
narrative.offerRewardText: It's ready! I present to you my greatest creation: Dirge's Kickin' Chimaerok Chops!
narrative.requestItemsText: Hurry it up, kid. We don't want this meat to go bad.
